title: Fundamentals of Accounting
info: Credit is not given for both ACCY 200 and either ACCY 201 or ACCY 202. Prerequisite: Sophomore standing.

sections.sectionText: Restricted to majors in Technical Systems Management, Crop Sciences, Food Science & Human Nutrition, Industrial Engineering, Actuarial Science, Systems Engineering and Design majors. This course will open to all of campus to allow business minors and prospective business minors the option to register on April 27th at approximately 10 am. This section has one or more proctored exams. Day1Access course materials cost $130.73. For more information see https://go.illinois.edu/Day1Access.
